name: 1Password Environments MCP
description: Lets coding agents in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Kiro manage 1Password Environments through a local MCP server, without the agent ever receiving secret values.

skills.name: Manage Secret Environments
skills.description: Creates, lists and renames 1Password Environments from an MCP client after you approve access in the 1Password app.

skills.name: Add Secrets Without Exposure
skills.description: Adds secrets to an Environment and lists their names, while the server never returns secret values to the agent.

skills.name: Mount Local .env Files
skills.description: Creates locally mounted .env files that supply secrets on demand without writing them to disk in plaintext.

skills.name: Validate .env Files
skills.description: Checks that mounted .env files are set up correctly before Cursor Agent runs shell commands, via the Cursor plugin hook.
